title: Boost Spark Retard (MAP x RPM)
folder: 20 Race - SD Fuel, Boost Spark, Anti-Lag
full_notes:
BOOST IGNITION RETARD vs manifold absolute pressure and RPM. SD-v4: used in gear AND in neutral/clutch-in whenever rolling anti-lag is not active. Repurposed stock "Trim B" map (stock values were all 64 = unused).

HOW THE ECU USES IT (SD-v3): FUN_525EE looks it up with X = RAW IAP sensor ADC fef02574 (code patch at 0x52600; stock X was throttle angle) and Y = RPM fef0155C; this table when in gear with clutch out. Output fef01671 -> weighted by fef01674 (enable weight, see "Boost Spark Retard - Enable Weight") -> fef01575 -> FUN_5171C takes the MAX of all retard requests...

Note: the idle/neutral timing path (fef01544, weighted by fef0157A) does not include this retard; it matters only in neutral/clutch-in with the idle path active.

These DTCs are hard-coded as supported/enabled (constant 0x80 in FUN_11010) and have no calibration switch - use the lamp toggle or the monitor thresholds instead: P0607 - ECM performance (internal processor); P0106 #1 - IAP/MAP sensor range/performance (not in Gen3 manual); P0138 - HO2 sensor B1S2 high (not used); P0136 - HO2 sensor B1S2 circuit (not used); P2A01 - HO2 sensor B1S2 range (not used); P0139 - HO2 sensor B1S2 slow (not used); P0158 - HO2 sensor B2S2 high (not used); P0156 - HO2 sensor B2S2 circuit (not used); P2A04 - HO2 sensor B2S2 range (not used); P0159 - HO2 sensor B2S2 slow (not used); P2102 - Throttle actuator (ETV motor) circuit low; P2101 - Throttle actuator (ETV motor) range/performance; P0036 - HO2 heater B1S2 (not used); P0056 - HO2 heater B2S2 (not used); P0010 - Cam actuator circuit (not used - no VVT); P003C - Cam profile actuator (not used); P0505 - Idle air control system (not in Gen3 manual); P0420 - Catalyst efficiency bank 1 (not in Gen3 manual); P0430 - Catalyst efficiency bank 2 (not in Gen3 manual); P0602 - ECM programming error - none (group 0x10) enabled.

This constant just re-displays the P1622 enable byte (0x1549F5) so the note has somewhere to live.

title: DTC Monitor Enable :: P0030 / P0050 - HO2 heater B1S1 control
full_notes:
Ticked (0x80) = the ECU runs this diagnostic monitor and can set P0030 / P0050. Unticked (0x00) = the monitor is skipped: the code never sets, no lamp, and the fault-driven fail-safe for it is not triggered. The same byte also tells the OBD service whether the monitor is supported (FUN_11010).

DTCs controlled by this byte: P0030 - HO2 heater B1S1 control; P0050 - HO2 heater B2S1 control.
STOCK (5JCZSJ10): 0x80 (monitor ON). Stock 5JCZSJ10 already has many emissions monitors switched off.
ADDRESS 0x154968. Monitor code checks "byte == 0x80" (example: FUN_32A24 for P2123). Use a full byte value of 0x80 or 0x00 - other values also count as OFF.
Related: the lamp toggles in "Diagnostics - DTC Lamp Control" only hide the lamp; this switch stops the monitor itself.

Ticked (0x80) = the ECU runs this diagnostic monitor and can set P0335. Unticked (0x00) = the monitor is skipped: the code never sets, no lamp, and the fault-driven fail-safe for it is not triggered. The same byte also tells the OBD service whether the monitor is supported (FUN_11010).
CAUTION: this monitor protects the throttle-by-wire / engine-position / ECM integrity / oil-pressure system. Turning it off hides a real fault and can stop the ECU from entering its fail-safe (for wheel-speed codes: traction/launch control keep running on bad data). Not recommended.

DTCs controlled by this byte: P0335 - CKP (crank position) sensor.
STOCK (5JCZSJ10): 0x80 (monitor ON). Stock 5JCZSJ10 already has many emissions monitors switched off.
ADDRESS 0x15498C. Monitor code checks "byte == 0x80" (example: FUN_32A24 for P2123). Use a full byte value of 0x80 or 0x00 - other values also count as OFF.
Related: the lamp toggles in "Diagnostics - DTC Lamp Control" only hide the lamp; this switch stops the monitor itself.

title: DTC P0069 - IAP vs AP (barometric) correlation - MIL enabled
full_notes:
Ticked = this DTC lights the MIL when it sets (stock). Unticked = the code still sets and is stored, but no lamp lights. DTC index 21, lamp byte @0x1B9828 (mask 0x01).

HOW IT WORKS: each DTC has a 20-byte record in the diagnostic table at 0x1B9678 (131 records). Byte +0x0C of the record is the lamp group: 0x01 = MIL. FUN_938A8 moves the DTC into classes 6-8, which FUN_99E2A turns into the MIL request. 0x40 (or 0x80) = master warning lamp only (FUN_941AC). 0x00 = no lamp. Unticking the flag only stops the lamp. The DTC is still stored, still readable with a scan tool, and the ECU still runs its fail-safe for that fault (for example, P0500 still turns off traction control).

On a fast throttle opening (Fuel Blend - Tip-In Rate Gate: TP rise of 1.41 deg or more within 4 samples) the TPS maps take 100% authority for 4 cycles. title: IAP - In Gear | Cyl 1
full_notes:
Main IAP (manifold-vacuum based) base fuel map for cylinder 1 while in gear with the clutch released. Output is a raw fuel quantity (injection time units) indexed by manifold vacuum and RPM.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: Code: FUN_45320 looks up all six maps of the cylinder 1 set (pointer table 0x16BDF4, index cyl*6+n); FUN_453B8 then uses map 1 as the result, blended with map 2 by a weight that is hard-coded to 0, so this map is the one that actually fuels cylinder 1. In neutral / clutch-in the "IAP - Neutral/Clutch-In | Cyl 1" map is used instead. Was "IAP - Mode A | Gear 1" in the DanCycles naming.

AXES: X axis: 30 points, 78.1 down to 0.0 kPa VACUUM (0 = atmospheric / WOT, 78 = high vacuum / closed throttle); Y axis: 50 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ10): 532 to 4872 fuel qty (raw).

TUNING NOTES: This is the cylinder 1 IAP fuel map you would normally tune. Changes here affect cylinder 1 only, so keep the four cylinder maps consistent unless you are correcting a cylinder-to-cylinder imbalance. HOW IT IS COMBINED: final base fuel = IAP_map x (256 - w) + TPS_map x w, where w (fef011CA) comes from FUN_491BC: w = 0 (100% this IAP map) below the "Fuel Blend - MAP->Throttle Threshold (vs RPM)" throttle angle, ramps to 256 over the next ~2.8 deg (Fuel Blend :: MAP->Throttle Ramp Width), and is forced to 256 (100% TPS map) for 4 cycles after a fast throttle opening (tip-in rate gate 0x1824C6: TP rise of 1.41 deg or more within 4 samples). So at light/part throttle this map fuels the engine; at large openings, WOT and on fast tip-in the TPS map does.

CONFIDENCE: Cylinder assignment confirmed from code (cyl*6 indexing) and from data (stock cylinder-to-cylinder offsets match the Neutral/Clutch-In Cyl 1-4 maps exactly in the same order).

title: TPS - In Gear | Cyl 1
full_notes:
Main alpha-N (throttle based) base fuel map for cylinder 1 while in gear with the clutch released. Output is a raw fuel quantity (injection time units) indexed by throttle angle and RPM.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: Code: FUN_4536c looks up all six maps of the cylinder 1 set (pointer table 0x17EBE4, index cyl*6+n); FUN_453B8 then uses map 1 as the result, blended with map 2 by a weight that is hard-coded to 0, so this map is the one that actually fuels cylinder 1. In neutral / clutch-in the "TPS - Neutral/Clutch-In | Cyl 1" map is used instead. Was "TPS - Mode A | Gear 1" in the DanCycles naming.

AXES: X axis: 26 points, 0.46 to 118 deg (abs. TP angle); Y axis: 50 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ10): 467 to 5351 raw (inj. time?).

TUNING NOTES: This is the cylinder 1 TPS fuel map you would normally tune. Changes here affect cylinder 1 only, so keep the four cylinder maps consistent unless you are correcting a cylinder-to-cylinder imbalance. How the TPS and IAP results are combined downstream has not been traced yet - change one family at a time and log.

CONFIDENCE: Cylinder assignment confirmed from code (cyl*6 indexing) and from data (stock cylinder-to-cylinder offsets match the Neutral/Clutch-In Cyl 1-4 maps exactly in the same order).

title: IGN :: Advance Timing - Cyl 1
full_notes:
Base ignition advance for cylinder 1, throttle angle x RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ10): 14.38 to 74.16 deg BTDC (OBD scale).

CONFIDENCE: Scale derived from FUN_556CA (OBD timing byte = 0x80 + 14 + (X-64)*90/128). Replaces the old DanCycles 0.4X-12.5 guess.

title: Launch Control | Level 3 | Hard Cut
full_notes:
Launch-control RPM limiter, level 3, threshold 4 of 4. Code: FUN_28E5E copies the 4 words for the selected LC level (RAM 0xFEF026D9 = 1/2/3) into 0xFEF009DA-E0; FUN_2BD08 then runs a staged limiter while LC is active (0xFEF00702 bit5). Word 1-3 = soft zone: 0xFEF009C1 bit1 -> per-cylinder pattern fuel cut (FUN_4B9DA -> 0xFEF01309 -> fuel-cut mode 3, skip pattern from 0x1826D9-0x1826E1). Word 4 = hard limit: 0xFEF009C1 bit0 -> full fuel cut on all injectors. No spark cut and no timing retard is used by the LC RPM limiter; throttle is capped separately by the "Launch Control - Throttle Limit" maps. Keep the four values ascending. Stock spacing is ~25-75 rpm.

IAP (manifold) sensor GAIN. FUN_742E2: counts = 7862 + (OFFSET-0x8000) + rawADC*GAIN*32/DIV, clamped 0..65535. DIV is a code immediate at 0x74302: stock 21850 (0x555A), SD-v3 10925 (0x2AAD) so a 3-bar sensor fits the stock internal scale (393.14 counts/kPa, 7862 = 0 kPa).
For a sensor kPa = a x rawADC + b:  GAIN = round(393.14 x a x DIV / 32),  OFFSET = round(32768 + 393.14 x b).
SD-v3 (a = 0.307429, b = -12.6): GAIN 41263 (0xA12F), OFFSET 27814 (0x6CA6). Internal IAP saturates at ~147 kPa - by design; SD fuel and boost spark read the raw ADC instead.
Keep 1023 x GAIN x 32 < 2^31 (GAIN < 65599).

title: ETV - PWR 1 | Gear 1
full_notes:
Throttle-by-wire target map for Power Mode 1, gear 1: converts grip (accelerator) angle and RPM into the throttle-valve angle the ECU drives the throttle motor to.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: FUN_7C4CE picks the map from pointer table 0x1AD7A4[gear*6 + slot] (gear: N=0..6th=6). The slot comes from per-gear selector bytes 0x18F13A-0x18F155 using the power mode of the active ride mode; stock: PWR 1 -> slot 1, PWR 2 -> slot 2, PWR 3 (and 4) -> slot 3; this map is slot 1. Ride mode presets at 0x18F120 (A), 0x18F127 (B), 0x18F12E (C) set PW = 1/2/3. The result can be further capped by the ETV Limit maps (min()).

AXES: X axis: 23 points, 0.00 to 107 deg (abs. accel angle); Y axis: 39 points, 800 to 16000 RPM.

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ10): 0.00 to 122.40 target throttle angle (deg).

TUNING NOTES: Values are target throttle angle in degrees (same scale as the SDS absolute throttle angle; ~118 deg is wide open). Raising cells opens the throttle further for the same grip input - this changes power delivery and is also capped by the limit maps and traction control.

CONFIDENCE: Selection logic confirmed from code. Was "ETV - Mode A | Gear 1" in the DanCycles naming (their Mode A/B/C = Power mode 1/2/3).

REFERENCE: data @0x191340, X axis @0x18FE0C, Y axis @0x1912F0, descriptor @0x18F360, code FUN_7c4ce.

Traction-control TARGET SLIP for TC level 10, 6th/N gear: how much rear-wheel slip is allowed before TC intervenes, as a function of estimated drive acceleration.

HOW THE ECU USES IT: FUN_4D602 selects the curve by TC level (RAM 0xFEF026D4, set by the ride mode preset / user mode, 1-10) and gear (gear bitmask 0xFEF026C2; 6th gear and neutral use the last entry); a separate set is used when the launch-control flag (0xFEF00702 bit6) is active. Input = estimated drive acceleration (RAM 0xFEF009D0 = engine-torque map x gear ratio / tyre radius - drag). Output -> RAM 0xFEF0134A. FUN_4DBD6 then computes slip error = (rear - front)/front x1000 - target, which drives the torque-cut curves.

AXES: X axis: 21 points, -1606 to 14460 raw (0x8000=0).

VALUES (stock 5JCZSJ10): 8.00 to 18.00 % target slip.

TUNING NOTES: Higher values allow more slip before TC cuts power (less intrusive). Change the matching level/gear only; the TC level actually used comes from the ride mode (A=1, B=5, C=10 in this calibration) or the user setting.

CONFIDENCE: Traced in the decompiled code (functions and RAM addresses given above); physical scaling of intermediate values partly inferred.
